notes.title: "tERRORbane: an INTRODUCTION, mostly" is now available!
notes.content:
"tERRORbane: an INTRODUCTION, mostly" is now available here on Steam!

Follow this link to visit the store page for tERRORbane the main game and add it to your wishlist: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1617030/tERRORbane/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1617030/tERRORbane/[/url]

If you enjoy your ride, don't forget to share [b]a review[/b] of your experience or [b]help your fellow players[/b] find all missing bugs in their collection!
